projects.title: V4 architecture
projects.description: Rebuilt a single-page app into a routed workspace-and-tab application, to a direction set by product and design: shared tables and multiple people editing the same records concurrently. Drove the backend, and worked on the frontend alongside two full-stack engineers. Every entity type resolves through one shared table layer, so views render through a single component instead of bespoke code per type. Mutations are recorded as operations and broadcast over scoped subscriptions, which made live collaboration and undo architectural properties rather than bolted-on features. Shipped alongside the old UI with no breaking changes, migrating one view at a time. Wrote the architecture reference the team then built from.
